rationale: Both contribution.md and the final message explicitly name Raman et al. 2026 / the white-bear steering result as the prior work, describe the same dependency (directed_modulation bench family plus per-layer unit-normalisation and a hand-set step) that the new method avoids, and make the same novelty claim (self-contained, family-free recipe) backed by the same specificity check (a non-stance contrast that failed, pass@10 -> 0). The message adds extra empirical detail (exact pass@10, dose curve values, log10 rank, injection-position comparison) not present in contribution.md, but this is elaboration of results rather than a difference in what is disclosed about the source, overlap, or novelty.
